sourceMethod: Literal pinned default-CSS/edge-selector and accessibility-documentation transcription plus PNG format observability. No candidate parser/model/render or captured image supplied the expected answer.
policy: Static PNG checks every observable source-owned label,shape,endpoint,marker,thickness,color and static dash/cap property. Only named temporal activation/absence/speed/progression/elapsed-dash-phase and nonpixel DOM/ARIA metadata are excluded. Original complete native/SVG contract remains canonical. Unknown/custom syntax receives no implicit projection.
strongConversion: The exact retained raster input SVG is freshly inspected against the projected PNG contract. Missing required static paint or a reused full temporal SVG plan cannot certify the PNG. Old PNG reviews receive no hash restamp; affected actual images require explicit current review decisions.
